name: iact_algol_magic_lst1
label: Algol A-B on MAGIC-I + MAGIC-II + LST-1 at 425 nm: the orbit in 12 one-hour slots at orbital phases spread outside the eclipses (12 h, a 30 h proposal with the other binary)
notes: Schedule: 12 slots of 1 h (three 20-min blocks) on nights every half period (quadratures), each slot at a different hour angle (options.slot_hours); the radii of the components are tied to the eclipse solution (ln a scales every angular size through the distance). The _free variant fits the two radii as well.

options.phases: the slots cycle through orbital phases 0, 0.5, 0.1, 0.6, 0.9, 0.4, ... (phase 0 = quadrature; the eclipses at 0.25 and 0.75 are avoided by > 0.1 in phase) so that the orbital fringe is sampled away from the quadratures, which is what separates the orbit from the stellar radii.
